headline: DeepSeek Flash hits #1, OpenAI surges 13.5% in a day of major shifts
summary: DeepSeek's v4-flash model claimed the top spot with 13.7% token share, up 1.0 percentage points in a single day, while OpenAI's collective share jumped to 13.5% — a 30-day climb of 8.2 percentage points. Xiaomi took a hard tumble from #1 to #3, losing 4.8 points of share overnight. Google's new Gemini 3.7 Flash set an all-time record at 1.8% share on its debut.
highlights: DeepSeek v4-flash (13.7%) and Tencent HY3 (12.9%) both climbed one rank, with DeepSeek now holding 23.7% of all provider share
Xiaomi MIMO v2.5 dropped 2 ranks to #3 after losing 4.8% share in 24 hours, though it's up 2.8% over the week
OpenAI's three newest models (Luna, Sol, Terra) all gained ground; Luna-Pro jumped 8 ranks to #22
Google Gemini 3.7 Flash debuts at #12 with an all-time token-share record of 1.8%
NVIDIA's free tier models climbing steadily: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning up 29 ranks week-over-week
Two new entrants (Qwen Flash, xAI Grok 4.5) and two dropouts (Qwen Max, Google Gemini 3.5 Flash)
